extracted.name: Easy Grilled Zucchini
extracted.description: This easy grilled zucchini recipe with just a bit of olive oil and grill seasoning makes a delicious zucchini side dish ready in less than 30 minutes.
instruction_lines: Preheat the grill to medium heat and lightly oil the grate.
Drizzle both sides zucchini slices with oil; season with grill seasoning.
Grill on the preheated grill until tender, 3 to 4 minutes per side.
